title: Stranger in Long John Silver's says read Ezekiel, Daniel, Revelations
summary: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen tells of Stranger in Long John Silver's says read Ezekiel, Daniel, Revelations, about 1976 at Long John Silver's restaurant, near Fort Knox, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Long John Silver's restaurant, near Fort Knox

tellings.quote: and this guy walks right up to me, who I describe in the book, and says, "Read Ezekiel, Daniel, Revelations." and walked away.

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former senior CIA officer, says that in 1976 he was in a Long John Silver's fast food restaurant near Fort Knox, a US Army post, when a stranger walked straight up to him. He says the man told him to read Ezekiel, Daniel and Revelation, three books of the Bible, then walked away. He describes it in his book A State of Mind: Faith in the CIA as a moment that seemed to carry a message meant for him.
